title: Emotional Abuse
summary: Emotional abuse is a pattern of words and actions used to control, frighten or belittle someone — insults, humiliation, threats, silent treatment as punishment, constant blame.
answer_guidance: Be warm, practical and neutral rather than preachy. Explain the idea, then offer one or two concrete suggestions if useful. Don't judge the user's partner from limited information.
